_doc: Real `sinatra-flash-0.3.0` vendored 1:1 under `vendor/sinatra/`. Sixth sinatra-contrib-family fixture (this gem is technically standalone, not in sinatra-contrib). Unblocked by three recent VM fixes: `Class.new` block-form (commit 21bb6c1d) + `class < <expr>` arbitrary parent expression (same commit) lets `class FlashHash < DelegateClass(Hash)` even construct, and Hash iter pair-yield (commit 6a8f1203) lets `styled_flash`'s `flash.collect { |message| ... }` see message as a pair Array instead of just a key. Exercises FlashHash's @now/@next dance and the styled_flash helper in single-request routes; cross-request session round-trip is verified separately at the Rack::Session::Cookie shim level.
name: sinatra_flash_smoke
